name: application-stacked-area-chart
title: Stacked Area Chart
description: A multi-series cumulative trend chart with layered areas and a toggleable legend, for comparing how several series contribute to a growing total over time.
useWhen: Showing how multiple series sum to a total over time — e.g. signups by channel, revenue by product line.
The overall trend (the top boundary) and each series' relative contribution both matter.
avoidWhen: Precise per-series comparison at a given point matters more than the cumulative total — a multi-line chart from `charts` is easier to read for that.
There are more than 4-5 series — stacked layers become hard to distinguish past that; consider a `Stacked Area Chart` alternative like small multiples instead.
responsiveBehavior: The chart is a single SVG with viewBox scaling that shrinks proportionally with its container; the legend wraps to a new line below the chart on narrow widths.
accessibility: Each series has a distinct color paired with a text label in the legend, not color alone.
Legend items are real buttons with aria-pressed reflecting whether that series is currently shown, supporting keyboard toggling in a real implementation.
Provide a text or table alternative of the underlying series data for screen reader users, since the stacked SVG areas are not independently announced.

variants.title: Three-series trend
variants.description: A 12-month signups-by-channel chart with three stacked series (Organic, Referral, Paid), gridlines, and a toggleable color-coded legend.
accessibility: Legend buttons carry aria-pressed to reflect each series' visibility state.

variants.title: Three-series trend (Dark)
variants.description: Stacked area chart adapted for dark surfaces, with series colors re-tuned for dark contrast.
accessibility: Series fills, boundary lines, and legend swatches all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
